sourceLaneDecisions.sourceName: O*NET Database and O*NET OnLine public occupational reference data
sourceLaneDecisions.licenseTermsPosture: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; owner accepts only with attribution and modification/license posture preserved.
sourceLaneDecisions.allowedSourceAtlasUse: Broad public occupational taxonomy, skills, abilities, knowledge, work activities, education/training, job zones, tools/technology, transferable skills, normalized public-reference records, and provenance receipts.
sourceLaneDecisions.forbiddenSourceAtlasUse: No private user data, no final user paths, no schedules, no Step lists, no unattributed redistribution, and no claim beyond public/reference authority.
sourceLaneDecisions.attributionRequirement: Required. Pack/evidence must retain O*NET attribution and license notice.
sourceLaneDecisions.risk: Attribution copy must remain present in pack/evidence; this is owner acceptance, not outside legal approval.
sourceLaneDecisions.requiredFollowUp: Keep attribution text in all future promoted Train 01-derived packs.

sourceLaneDecisions.licenseTermsPosture: Official U.S. government public data lane; cite BLS as source. Version 1.0 no-key lane is allowed; Version 2.0 remains optional/key-based.
sourceLaneDecisions.allowedSourceAtlasUse: Published public labor-market, wage, employment, and occupation context in low-volume no-key v1 mode for Train 01.
sourceLaneDecisions.forbiddenSourceAtlasUse: No secret-dependent production requirement; no hidden v2-key requirement for Green; no private user data; no final paths, schedules, or Step lists.
sourceLaneDecisions.risk: BLS v2 key mode was not required for Train 01 Green; BLS_API_KEY was not required or used for the v1 proof lane.
sourceLaneDecisions.requiredFollowUp: Use explicit BLS_API_KEY and rate posture before any future v2/high-volume proof claim.

sourceLaneDecisions.licenseTermsPosture: Structured data in main/property/lexeme namespaces is CC0; owner accepts crosswalk/ontology support only.
sourceLaneDecisions.allowedSourceAtlasUse: QID crosswalks, aliases, labels, entity linking candidates, ambiguity preservation, and ontology support.
sourceLaneDecisions.forbiddenSourceAtlasUse: Must not act as regulated requirement authority or silently resolve conflicted/low-confidence matches.
sourceLaneDecisions.attributionRequirement: Not required by CC0, but source/provenance remains recorded.
sourceLaneDecisions.risk: Community-edited data can be incorrect or conflicted; confidence and review routing remain required.
sourceLaneDecisions.requiredFollowUp: Keep regulated claims from becoming Green based on Wikidata alone.

sourceLaneDecisions.forbiddenSourceAtlasUse: No assumption of unlimited free production API volume; no regulated authority substitution; no private user data.
sourceLaneDecisions.attributionRequirement: Not required by CC0, but source/provenance remains recorded.
sourceLaneDecisions.risk: Future high-volume production refresh needs explicit API budget/key/rate review.
sourceLaneDecisions.requiredFollowUp: Document API key/rate budget before any high-volume refresh train.
